name: Cable ladder / tray
summary: A generic route object connecting cable-support layout to the selected system.
description: A cable-support route identifies where a selected tray or ladder system carries cables through an arrangement. Straight lengths, bends, fittings and supports belong to a manufacturer system, and their dimensions and capabilities should be documented for that selection.
readingNotes: Read the route and changes of direction together with support and fitting information.
Distinguish cable-routing space from the physical support-system envelope.
drawingChecklist: Identify route levels, fittings and interfaces.
Link the cable and support documentation.
distinction: A drawn route does not establish support spacing, loading capability or installation compliance.
